# Career Exploration and Awareness Programs
- Video/PDF
  - Career exploration programs help high school students identify strengths, interests, and career paths through self-assessment tools, career information sessi…
  - Key components include mentorship, skill-building workshops, and educational planning.
  - These programs foster informed decision-making, skill development, confidence, and networking.
  - Effective implementation involves collaboration with stakeholders, tailoring programs to student needs, and continuous evaluation.
